column1: # The box's idle-fill list: the work a card takes when nothing of ours is queued for it. One owner: this file.
# tools/boxq.py fill-list parses it and refuses a row whose recipe is not in the justfile; docs/plan-triage.md points here.
# Tab-separated, four columns, blank and `#` lines skipped:
#   item      a justfile recipe name, or `cmd:<command>` for work that is not a recipe
#   lane      3090 | a6000 | both | any | none — the card the item holds, read from the recipe's own box.sh/gpu-gate.sh
#             line (BLOOMERY_CARD=both: both; BLOOMERY_GATE_CARD=${...:-any}: any; no card variable: the box.sh pin, 3090)
#   minutes   times:<item> — the median of the item's last rows in the gate-times file, resolved when the job is
#             queued — or given:<minutes> for an item with no times row
#   why       one line: what the item is for
# The recipe's justfile groups (solo, v41-load) are read from the justfile by fill-list, not repeated here.
